trigger: host running both yuzu-server and yuzu-agent packages (unit's own --server %H:50051 default assumes self-hosting; this box's own UAT rigs run both together)
summary: EnvironmentFile= placed under shared /etc/yuzu, which the server package's postinst re-asserts 0750 yuzu:yuzu on every install/upgrade; directory-write lets that different service account unlink/replace the agent's root:root 0600 rollback-lever file, defeating confinement and the ADR-0021 rollback guarantee

independent_reporters: 1 of 3 (Gate 8 wave); self-confirmation of own prior finding
summary: Gate 8 re-review: RESOLVED. Relocation to /etc/yuzu-agent/ verified against current postinst/build-deb.sh/rpm specs - zero collision; systemd-analyze verify re-run clean.

trigger: operator copies deploy/config/yuzu-agent.env.example's own template line verbatim
summary: Template header note still said '/etc/yuzu/*.env' after the security fix relocated the real mechanism to /etc/yuzu-agent/ - the one file titled 'copy this and set values' would silently defeat the rollback lever if followed; derived SHOULD not BLOCKING because rung 1 has zero operational impact (legacy IGuard enforces unconditionally regardless of spark-disable state) and the two authoritative docs (spark-flip-gate.md, guaranteed-state.md) already state the correct path - fixed anyway given 4-agent convergence
adjudicated_by: orchestrator (derived band overrides consistency-auditor's self-labeled BLOCKING per standing rule 2)

summary: 'agent-owned' is factually wrong (file is root:root, not agent-owned) - risked an operator chown-ing the file to the agent account, defeating the confinement fix. Wording-only per standing rule 3, capped at NICE.

trigger: operator writes a malformed value (e.g. trailing inline comment) to the env file
summary: Crash-loop recovery sequence (systemctl reset-failed) after a malformed-value-triggered StartLimitBurst trip was not documented; empirically confirmed via scratch systemd --user unit that the failure mode is real (raw uncleaned trailing-comment value reaches the environment verbatim)

Filesystem-hierarchy table had no row for the new file and didn't explain its mode divergence (0600 root:root) from the documented /etc/yuzu-agent/ convention (0640 root:agent) - added row with explicit guard note against future automation reintroducing the confinement bug
Windows/macOS follow-up cited as 'not yet filed' - filed for real as #3973 (dedupe probes empty) and cross-reference updated in both the changelog and docs/spark-flip-gate.md
No pointer from server-admin.md's systemd/crash-loop section to the new env-file mechanism - added a cross-reference paragraph

Production EnvironmentFile= mechanism was never exercised end-to-end by any test/CI/UAT (only man-page reading + systemd-analyze verify + CLI11 probes) - closed by orchestrator running a real scratch systemd --user unit with the identical directive shape, confirming both the happy path and the malformed-value path empirically

rpm auto-restarts on upgrade (%systemd_postun_with_restart), deb does not (postinst only daemon-reload) - 'takes effect at next restart' papered over the asymmetry; now stated explicitly in both the changelog and the drill
Changelog fragment cited #3851 (the issue it closes) as its own Windows/macOS follow-up tracker - fixed pre-governance in 163ac9456

trigger: co-installed server+agent host, self-tamper scenario (agent's own account, not the server's)
independent_reporters: 1 of 2 (withdrawn by reporter in Phase 2; independently rejected by Codex with matching evidence)
summary: Kimi's Phase-1 scenario assumed the agent's OWN account owned /etc/yuzu on a co-installed host - factually wrong (only COMPONENT==yuzu-server creates it); withdrawn by Kimi itself in Phase 2, independently rejected by Codex. Different threat model from sec-H1 (which found the SERVER account, not the agent's own, was the real actor) - the adversarial review's blind spot here is exactly what governance's security-guardian caught separately.
